rows.grounds: imperative request to sever or remove
compound denoting darkness arising from doubt; object of removal

items.question: What divine grace can remove the darkness born from a devotee's doubt?
premises: The speaker presents himself as a devotee seeking favor.
Doubt gives rise to a darkness that obscures understanding.
Divine grace is capable of severing this darkness.
items.inference: Therefore the devotee petitions the deity to be gracious and cut away doubt-born darkness.
items.plain_english: Be gracious to me, your devotee; cut away the darkness born of doubt.
